name: ultraDevs AI Summarizer Block
author: ultraDevs

sections.description:
ultraDevs AI Summarizer Block is a lightweight and powerful WordPress plugin that allows your readers to quickly summarize your articles using their favorite AI platforms. With a sleek, modern, and customizable interface, this block enhances user experience by providing instant insights.

Key Features:

  • Multiple AI Platforms: Supports ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, and Grok.
  • Modern Design: Premium circular icons with glassmorphism effects.
  • Fully Customizable: Adjust icon sizes (24px to 64px) and choose which platforms to display per block instance.
  • Global Settings: Easily enable/disable platforms across your entire site from a central settings page.
  • Privacy Focused: The plugin simply constructs a prompt and redirects the user to the AI platform, ensuring no content is stored or processed on your server.
  • Inline Layout: Compact design that fits perfectly within any post or page layout.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ultradevs-ai-summarizer-block folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure your desired AI platforms in ‘Settings’ -> ‘ultraDevs AI Summarizer Block’.
  4. Add the ‘ultraDevs AI Summarizer Block’ block to any post or page using the Gutenberg editor.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Support for ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, and Grok.
  • Added block-level controls for icon size and platform selection.
  • Modern monochrome icon set.
